AccentStroke.description: Hand-painted vector stroke overlay drawn on top of a [`PhotoStep`].

oneOf.description: Sweeping hand-drawn circle with an accent tip around a radial rosette.
Top slash + exclamation stroke (`ask` → `ask !`).
Calligraphic flourish header + baseline underline (`task`).
Horizontal red strike-through morphing the leading letter (`draft` → `craft`).
Sweeping calligraphic arc over the subject's crest + bottom scale rule.
Hand-drawn ink + accent oval circling the eye/head.
Precision geometric target reticle + cardinal ticks over the focal point.
Technical caliper bracket `[` with an accent locus dot.
Double-ring anatomical circle + accent locus dot.
Accent ink drop / period dot (`Keep` → `Keep thinking.`).
Flat colour.
Soft radial falloff from the centre (needs `allow: ["gradient"]`).
Gentle top-to-bottom falloff (needs `allow: ["gradient"]`).

Bed.description:
A bundled track (`assets/music/<track>.mp3`) played from `start` seconds
into the file; it fades out over the last `fade_out` seconds.

gain_db.description: Level offset on the track's own analysed gain (dB).

oneOf.description: Recursive Golden Ratio (61.8% / 38.2%) Fibonacci subdivision grid.

BentoTile.description: One metric or architecture card inside a [`Bento`] grid.

accent.description: Highlight this tile as an accent hero card.

detail.description: Optional mono sub-caption (1..=28 chars, e.g. `"VS PUBLIC CLOUD"`, `"NVME TIERING"`).

stat.description: Primary hero metric or badge (1..=12 chars, e.g. `"40%"`, `"2X"`, `"1-MIN"`, `"vSAN ESA"`).

title.description: Concise label (1..=22 chars, e.g. `"LOWER TCO"`, `"VM DENSITY"`, `"RPO RECOVERY"`).

CameraEvent.description: A camera move at program seconds `at` or music `beat`.

oneOf.description: Zoom to this factor (1..=1.8) about the current centre.
Centre the frame on a slot.
Frame a component: centre it and zoom so it fills ~70 % of the frame.
2.5D camera orbit `[yaw_deg, pitch_deg]` in `-35..=35`.
2.5D camera dolly along Z in `-600..=600` px (negative pushes in, positive pulls back).
Dutch angle camera roll in `-25..=25` degrees.
Rack depth-of-field focus to `z` px with optional `aperture` (`0.0..=1.0`).
Back to the full frame.

A spring response from `values[0]` to `values[1]`: the curve is
drawn by the same closed-form spring that moves its dot.
Thin muted axis, one accent series.
Ink series on paper; the hero in accent.

CodeBlock.description:
Mono code typed in with a caret: lines, a language for colouring and
steps (`type`, `retype`, `dissolve`, `highlight`).

lines.description: 1..=14 lines of at most 48 characters (no tabs).

oneOf.description: Ink on the page, muted line numbers, accent keywords.
A dark window (ink) with light type and a title bar.
Type line `line` (0-based) at 0.05 s a character.
Delete line `line` back to its start, then type `to` in its place.

Line `line` crumbles into ink speckles; with `to`, a serif italic
word rises in its place.
A band sweeps in behind line `line` (once per line).

at.description: Seconds from the component start (fallback when no `beat`/`bar`).

bar.description: On the downbeat of bar n (beat 4n) instead.

beat.description: On music beat n instead (program beat grid, snapped to a frame).

Component.description:
One component: on screen from `start` to `end` (default: the program
end), with a kind-specific preset and content, animated by `timeline`.

oneOf.description: Full-frame ground.

image.description:
Optional relative path under `assets/` to a background image plate
(e.g. `"generated/idea_1_bg.png"`), composited over the ground colour.

image_opacity.description: Opacity of the background image plate (`0.05..=1.0`, default `0.24`).

oneOf.description: One hero primitive that keeps its identity and morphs.

anchor.description:
The component this shape marks (it is centred on that
component's slot). A shape that neither changes (morph, move,
orbit, bounce, fill, spin) nor anchors to content is decoration
and is rejected (`slop_meaningless_shape`).

mark.description:
How an anchored shape marks its anchor's measured bounds: a ring
around them (≤ 1.12×), an underline, or a marker dot at the edge.

oneOf.description: A short line of type.

style.description: Type treatment: fill (solid, gradient, image), outline, letter case.

oneOf.description: Big type, a few words per frame, advanced by `cut` verbs.

beat_cuts.description:
With music: cut to the next word every this many beats from the
component's `start_beat` (adds `cut` events; explicit cuts stay).

dot.description:
An accent dot ends every word like a full stop and hops to the
next word on each cut (one element carried across the cuts).

ground.description:
Poster ground swatch (default: background; `flip` swaps it with
the type colour).

stress.description: Indices of words set in the accent.

style.description: Type treatment: fill (solid, gradient, image), outline, letter case.

words.description:
Shown one after another (1..=40 items of 1..=24 characters);
the first at the component start, each `cut` shows the next.

oneOf.description: A chart with one hero value.

beat_cuts.description:
With music: reveal one value per this many beats from
`start_beat` (bar i on beat i), then the hero lands.

callout.description: Big number shown at the hero, at most 12 characters.

colour.description:
Series and hero colour (default: the preset's; set it when the
chart sits on an accent-coloured ground).

hero.description: The value the chart is about (dot, accent, callout).

labels.description: Empty, or one short label per value.

title.description:
What the chart measures, set above it (at most 32 characters,
e.g. "Weekly signups, thousands").

oneOf.description:
Nodes and edges built step by step: each `advance` reveals the next
node (its edge draws first) and an accent dot travels the edge.

beat_cuts.description: With music: advance every this many beats from `start_beat`.

colour.description: Node outline/fill and dot colour override (default: preset's).

edges.description: `[from, to]` node indices; default: a chain 0→1→2…

oneOf.description: Frame furniture: up to four tiny mono labels in the corners.

corners.description:
`[top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right]`; empty strings
leave a corner blank. At most 24 characters each.

oneOf.description: Mono code typed in with a caret (`steps`: type, retype, dissolve, highlight).
A phone, laptop or bare stage with a morphing UI container, a cursor and a camera.
A dense, structured metric and feature card grid with 2.5D card tilt and step reveals.

beat_cuts.description: With music: reveal the next tile every this many beats from `start_beat`.

tilt_in.description: Optional 2.5D card tilt entrance angle `[pitch_deg, yaw_deg]` (default: `[-12.0, 8.0]`).

title.description: Optional section header above the grid (at most 32 characters).

oneOf.description:
A closing typographic lockup: headline, a line under it and the
rules that frame them.

badge.description: Optional custom badge / status pill label (`"EDITION"`, `"LIVE"`, `"SOVEREIGN"`).

headline.description: 1..=24 characters, set in the brand's chosen headline face and case.

headline_case.description: Optional letter-case override for the headline (`upper`, `preserve`).

headline_font.description: Optional font role override for the headline (`display`, `serif`, `mono`, `sans`).

rules_from.description:
Where the rules arrive from: a cubic Bézier in frame fractions
(x right, y down; start, two controls, end). They spring straight
into baselines. Absent: they grow out from the centre.

subline.description: The line under it, at most 48 characters.

subline_case.description: Optional letter-case override for the subline (`upper`, `preserve`).

subline_font.description: Optional font role override for the subline (`serif`, `mono`, `sans`, `display`).

oneOf.description: An editorial engraving / cutout collage sequence with hand-drawn strokes and word-pair morphs.

beat_cuts.description:
With music: advance to the next step every this many beats from
`start_beat`.

steps.description: Sequence of shots in time order (1..=32).

oneOf.description: A `p5.brush` natural media sketch, flow field, hatched drafting composition, or Golden Spiral study.

beat_cuts.description: With music: stagger element reveals every this many beats.

elements.description: Elements for `Freeform` (or additional overlays on presets).

field.description: Global vector field for this sketch (`hand`, `waves`, `curved`, `spiral`, etc.).

plate.description:
Draw the framed drafting plate (border, paper ground, title bar).
`false`: strokes only, on a transparent box, so the sketch can sit
`over` a title, photo_stack or chart (title/caption are then
rejected; use a `title` component).

size.description:
Box size in the slot (default `m` = today's box; `s` 0.6x,
`l` 1.15x, `xl` nearly the whole frame, centred).

title.description: Optional headline/title displayed in a clean high-contrast plate.

oneOf.description: A full-frame field of dots (one instanced primitive).

focus.description: Halftone: where the dots are largest (default: the centre).

depth.description: Optional 2.5D parallax depth factor (`0.0` = pinned ground, `1.0` = subject plane, `>1.0` = foreground).

end.description: Seconds from the program start; absent = the program end.

end_beat.description:
End on this music beat (cut there, on the same frame grid as the
next shot's start; overrides `end`).

id.description: Unique id: lowercase letters, digits and `_`.

start_beat.description: Start on this music beat instead (overrides `start`).

tilt.description: Optional static 2.5D projective card tilt `[pitch_deg, yaw_deg]` in `-65..=65`.

timeline.description: Verbs in time order; `at` is seconds from the component start.

z.description: Optional true 2.5D Z coordinate in px (`0.0` = focus plane, `>0.0` = farther, `<0.0` = closer).

oneOf.description: No hardware: the UI sits on the page (a pointer taps it).

DeviceFrame.description:
A phone, a laptop or a bare stage with one UI container that morphs
between `states`, driven by `steps` (`to_state`, `click`, `hold`,
`toast`, `zoom`). Sizes are real iOS points; the camera frames them.

flow.description:
A typed flow (`payment`, `signup`, ...): states, steps and copy
are derived from its fields. Give either `flow` or `states`.

states.description:
1..=8 UI states (free text, validated for point of view, one
success at a time and app context); the first shows from the start.

steps.description:
In time order, at least 0.45 s apart (zoom excepted); `at` is seconds
from the component start, or `beat`/`bar` on the music grid. Every
state holds for its read time (0.4 s + 0.3 s a line, 0.6 s at least).

oneOf.description: Light iOS: a #F2F2F7-like screen, white surfaces.
Dark iOS: a black screen, raised grey surfaces.
Ink outlines on the ground, mono labels, thin connectors.
Filled cards (ink on light / light on dark), bold labels.
Round nodes on a line, like a process rail.
Scale up from nothing on a small-overshoot spring.
Rise a short way while fading in.
Fade in.

Outline shapes: the stroke draws on; charts build; fields grow
out from the centre.
Titles: a mask wipes left to right.

Event.description:
A verb at `at` seconds from the component start, or on music `beat` n
(snapped to the nearest frame).

oneOf.description: Arrive. Without an `enter`, a component cuts in at its start.
Leave. Without an `exit`, a component cuts out at its end.
Shapes: become another shape (one shape, never cut).
Travel to another slot on a spring.
Change colour to another swatch (once per component).
A short struck-and-settle scale hit (one overshoot, no repeats).

Kinetic text: show the next word (hard cut); `flip` swaps ground and
ink from this word on.
Charts: the hero dot and callout pop in.
Shapes: a hop up and a spring landing.
Shapes: travel to a slot along an arc.
Shapes: grow until the shape covers the whole frame.
Shapes: shrink back from `fill` to their own size.
Shapes: turn a half turn and settle.
Fields: a recolour that travels outward from the focus as a wave.
Diagrams: reveal the next node. Charts: reveal the next value.

Lockups: a specular highlight travels across the headline once,
left to right.
2.5D projective tilt from `[pitch_deg, yaw_deg]` to `[pitch_deg, yaw_deg]`.
Motion trail echoes (`2..=6` copies behind a moving/scaling layer).

Gone on the next frame: a hard cut (the default; crossfades read as
slop).
Scale down to nothing.
Drop a short way while fading out.
Titles: a mask wipes off to the right.

Face.description: Bundled faces (assets/fonts, each under its own licence; restricted faces fall back to open ones, see assets/fonts/RESTRICTED.md).

oneOf.description: Gradient backdrops.
Dots that shrink away from the centre.
An even dot grid.
Dots on concentric rings.
Rounded squares on a coarse grid (a tile board).

Film.description: Faint, constant film texture (applied after everything else).

fringe.description: Red/blue fringe in px at 1080 p, 0..=3.

oneOf.description:
Send `amount` to `counterparty`: app icon → payment sheet → hold to
send → tick → receipt (same sheet).
Create an account (`item` = the app or plan): form → welcome.
Upload `item`: card → hold (progress) → tick → uploaded card.
Share `item` with `counterparty`: share sheet → tap them → shared.
Turn on the `item` setting: a settings card whose switch flips.

GenAsset.description: One image to generate before rendering (see `MotionProgram.assets`).

aspect.description: Canvas shape (default: the program's aspect for `plate`, 1:1 for `cutout`).

id.description: Referenced as `"gen:<id>"`; lowercase letters, digits and `_`.

prompt.description: What to draw: subject, medium and light, no on-screen words.

seed.description: Explicit seed: the same prompt and seed give the same image.

GenKind.description: What a generated asset is for.

oneOf.description: A full-frame picture or texture (backdrop image, image-filled type).
One isolated object with a transparent background.

Hit.description:
One SFX hit: `sound` is a library family (`hit_hard`, `whoosh_soft`,
`subdrop`, ...) or an exact sound id (`hit_hard_03`).

gain_db.description: Offset from the family's target peak (dB).

oneOf.description: One giant word per frame on a full-frame ground; hard cuts, slow push.
Letters drop in with one small overshoot.
Letters type on.

LockupCase.description: Letter-casing mode for a brand's closing lockup text.

LockupFont.description: Font role selector for a brand's closing lockup headline or subline.

oneOf.description: Classic horizontal rules springing from `rules_from` with centered headline and subline.

Asymmetric Swiss / Brutalist split colophon: left-aligned brandmark,
vertical accent pillar divider, right-hand bordered mono spec cards + accent status pill.

Geometric / Scientific circular seal: solid backing disc, concentric precision reticle rings
with cardinal ticks and counter-rotation, centered mark + subline.

Developer / CLI command stamp: dark terminal window with header dots, typed CLI prompt
(`> headline`), subline readout, and spec line.

Editorial / Luxury framed plaque: double-bordered museum frame, custom top accent badge,
mixed-case or upright headline, short accent bar, and custom subline.

brief.description:
The request this program answers (direction, not script): QA fails
on-screen words copied from it unless they were quoted.

end_beat.description:
With music: end on this beat (the final hit). `duration` becomes
that beat plus most of one beat of hold, so no beat plays after it.

name.description: File-safe name: lowercase letters, digits and `_`.

Music.description:
A bundled track (`assets/music/<track>.mp3` with its `.music.json`
analysis). Beat `n` is the n-th analysed beat at or after `start`.

start.description: Seconds into the track where the program starts.

Palette.description:
Four colours, `#RRGGBB`. Components name a swatch, never a colour, so a
program has exactly one accent.

grounds.description:
Up to 4 extra full-frame grounds (`ground1`..`ground4`): sections
can each live in their own colour world while keeping one accent.

PhotoLayout.description: Visual layout grammar for one step of a [`PhotoStack`].

oneOf.description: Geometric emblem mark + editorial serif wordmark, or radial rosette circle.

Serif word-pair morph (`ask` → `task`, `draft` → `craft`, `Keep` → `thinking.`)
with optional cutouts and ruled lines.
Scale variety "many": 3×3 grid of engravings/cutouts with a marked centre cell.
Circular 12-spoke zoetrope ring of silhouettes rotating around an accent dot.
Scale variety "big": single hero cutout with hand-drawn accent strokes on top.
Radial geometric construction blueprint.
Multi-layer 2.5D/3D extruded geometric emblem rotating in perspective.
Sparse star-field with constellation lines drawing to an accent pointer.
Woodcut circle-in-square geometric study with chords and sweeping arc.

PhotoPreset.description: Preset treatment and stroke aesthetic for a [`PhotoStack`].

oneOf.description:
High-contrast monochrome engraving/sculpture cutouts on light ground
with hand-drawn ink & terracotta accent strokes (`Path` + `Trim`).
Clean editorial cutouts with bold framing rules.
Layered depth cutouts with parallax camera push.

PhotoStep.description: One fast cut or state inside a [`PhotoStack`].

assets.description: Multiple cutout asset ids (for `grid` or paired cutouts in `word_morph`).

at.description: Seconds from the component's start (filled from `beat` or `beat_cuts`).

beat.description: Music beat on which this step cuts in.

ruled.description: Draw horizontal ledger/notebook baselines across the frame.

text.description: Primary serif word or brand name (e.g. `"ask"`, `"draft"`, `"Studio"`).

oneOf.description: Off-white, black and one orange; heavy grotesk; fast cuts.
Dark navy, thin axes, one gold series.
Cream ground, one orange dot, muted dot fields.
Solid fill.
Stroke only (can `draw` on).

ShapeSpec.description: A named primitive, or `{"path": "<svg path data>"}` in a 100×100 box.

oneOf.description: SVG path data in a 100×100 box (`M L H V C S Q T A Z`).

Size.description: Relative size (shapes: share of the short side; titles: type size).

SketchBrush.description: Natural media brush presets supported by the sketch engine.

SketchElement.description: An individual drawable natural-media mark or polygon.

oneOf.description: Straight line segment between normalized `[0..1]` points.
Smooth cubic spline passing through control points with optional per-point pressures.
Streamline following the sketch vector field from a start coordinate.
Normalized rectangle `[x, y, w, h]` with optional corner radius.
Circle with center and radius in normalized coordinates, plus hand irregularity.
Circular arc between two angles (in degrees, clockwise).
Closed polygon through normalized vertex coordinates.
Arbitrary SVG path data in normalized `0..1000` space, scaled to slot box.

pressure.description: Optional pressure curve `[start, mid, end]` or `[start, end]`.

tip_asset.description: Optional custom brush tip image asset.

brush.description: Brush preset used to stroke hatch lines.

cross.description: If true, adds perpendicular cross-hatch lines.

gradient.description: Density gradient along hatch direction (0.0 = uniform).

rand.description: Randomness of line placement and jitter (default: 0.08).

SketchPreset.description: Layout and composition presets for a [`Sketch`].

oneOf.description: Renders user-authored `elements` in normalized `[0.0..1.0]` box coordinates.

Euclid/Fibonacci Golden Rectangle + Logarithmic Spiral study with watercolor wash
chambers, hatched golden squares, and charcoal spiral curve leading into the golden eye.
Organic multi-streamline flow field tapestry around a calm central editorial title card.

Architectural elevation and drafting composition with geometric cross-hatching,
technical rotring callouts, and watercolor wash accents.

angle_deg.description: Optional dominant flow angle of the pigment bleed.

bleed.description: Bleed intensity beyond the shape boundary (default: 0.35).

inward.description: If true, bleed pools inward rather than bleeding out past the contour.

Slot.description:
Where a component sits. `lead`/`trail` are the left/right thirds in
landscape and the upper/lower thirds in portrait and square frames.

oneOf.description: Titles: left-aligned near the top-left corner (chapter labels).
Titles: left-aligned near the bottom-left corner.

SoundDesign.description: A bed and hits, placed by hand at program seconds.

oneOf.description: Heavy grotesk, tight.
Serif italic, quiet.
Small mono caps, tracked.
Bold small caps: a section/chapter name (use with `top_left`).
Big heavy caps with two offset echoes (accent, then muted) behind.

TransitionEvent.description: A transition at program seconds `at` or music `beat` (the cut point).

oneOf.description:
The camera whips sideways out of one shot and into the next, with
directional blur at the cut.
An accent panel wipes across and off, carrying the eye over the cut.

A landing: a two-frame shockwave ring from the frame centre, a short
motion blur and a decaying camera shake.
The preset's case (most presets set display type in capitals).
Exactly as written.
The component's colour.
A linear gradient between two swatches across the line's box.

angle_deg.description: Gradient direction in degrees (0 = left to right).

oneOf.description:
An image seen through the glyphs (a text mask), cover-fit to the
line's box. Relative path under `assets/`.

TypeStyle.description: How a line of type is painted. Absent = solid colour, the preset's case.

outline.description: Stroke the glyph outlines (in the fill colour) instead of filling them.

UiFlow.description: A product flow on one actor's device; states and copy are derived.

actor.description:
Whose device this is (a first name, or "You" = unnamed; signup
greets a name).

amount.description: Payment: the amount with its currency, e.g. "€24.00".

app.description: The app's name (its icon opens the flow), at most 12 characters.

counterparty.description: The other person (payment, share): a first name.

item.description:
The thing acted on: payment's source account, signup's app or plan,
upload's and share's file, toggle's setting.

note.description: A short note (payment's memo, upload's destination).

reply.description:
Later news from the counterparty as their verb phrase, e.g. "liked
your payment"; shown as a notification after the result. Never a
repeat of what the screen shows.

oneOf.description: A tick in a filled circle, drawn on.
A 44 pt capsule sized to its label.
A full-width 54 pt button (at the bottom of a phone screen).
A 64 pt notification under the island.
A centred card: title, rows, optional amount and button.
A bottom sheet: grabber, title, amount, rows, button.
A 120 pt app icon.

amount.description: Card and sheet: the hero number (at most 10 characters).

cta.description: Card and sheet: the primary button's label (at most 20 characters).

detail.description: A quieter line under the title, at most 36 characters.

fill.description: Container colour (default: the surface; never the ground).

icon.description: A leading vector icon (pills, buttons and toasts).

items.description: Card and sheet rows (at most 4, 24 characters each).

switches.description:
Rows with a switch instead of a chevron (on/off per row, in row
order); tapping such a row flips it in place.

oneOf.description: The container morphs to state `state`.

A tap: on the row the next state names (or `row`), else the button,
else the container; with `then`, the container morphs to that state
at the step time (the tap lands 0.12 s before it).

Press and hold the button for `secs` (0.4..=2.0): progress fills it,
it collapses to a circle and a tick draws on; with `then`, the
container morphs to that state 1.1 s after the release.

State `state` (a toast) grows out of the island, holds `hold` s
(default 1.6, at least its read time) and goes back in.
Camera: `in` frames the current state, `out` shows the whole device.

at.description: Seconds from the component start (fallback when no `beat`/`bar`).

bar.description: On the downbeat of bar n (beat 4n) instead.

beat.description: On music beat n instead (program beat grid, snapped to a frame).

description:
A MotionEngine 2 program: palette, type, tempo and components on one
explicit timeline. Compiles deterministically to a MotionScene.

allow.description:
Opt-in features that the taste rules ban by default (added to the
recipe's).

assets.description:
Images generated before rendering, from a prompt. Any image path in
the program may name one as `"gen:<id>"`. Generated once per
(prompt, kind, aspect, seed) and cached; the render never waits on a
network or model call.

camera.description:
Program camera: pushes, pans and framing over every component
(grounds stay put), on the same clock as the timeline.

components.description: Drawn back to front in list order.

film.description:
A film finish over the whole program: faint grain and a soft
chromatic fringe.

fonts.description:
Type faces per role; default: the recipe's, else the heavy grotesk +
serif italic + mono set.

music.description:
A bundled music bed; its offline beat analysis lets events and
components use `beat` instead of seconds.

palette.description: Required unless a recipe gives one.

recipe.description:
A style recipe: palette, type, tempo and allowances in one name.
Explicit `palette`/`fonts`/`tempo`/`allow` override it.

sound.description:
Sound design without a beat clock: a bed and SFX hits at program
seconds (a beat-led program uses `music` instead).

tempo.description: Global speed of every verb: slow ×1.35, normal ×1, fast ×0.75.

transitions.description: Shot transitions at program times (or beats).

title: MotionProgram
